evidence.title: Otter Meeting Agent - AI Notetaker, Transcription, Insights
Otter's Voice Meeting & Real-time Transcription Features | Otter.ai

name: Otter.ai
summary: AI meeting agent that records, transcribes and summarises meetings into searchable notes, summaries and action items.
description: Otter sends an AI notetaker to Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet, or records bot-free from desktop and mobile, producing live transcripts with speaker labels, summaries, decisions and action items. Otter AI Chat answers questions across your meetings, and integrations push notes to Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Notion and Jira.
contains: free plan: 300 monthly transcription minutes and 3 lifetime file imports
Pro from $16.99/user/month; Business and Enterprise tiers
live transcription in English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Chinese
automated summaries, action items and insights
integrations: Zoom, MS Teams, Google Meet, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Notion, Jira, Dropbox, Google Drive
desktop app for Mac and Windows, iOS and Android apps, Chrome extension
Otter MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude and other AI chat tools
Otter API and webhooks on the Enterprise plan
